# Vendored FUEL planning modules

This tree contains planning modules from [HKUST FUEL](https://github.com/HKUST-Aerial-Robotics/FUEL), revision `662dd23c7b52b258d3c4a0155ff6632118e8984f`, adapted for the MID360 / PX4 real-flight integration.

The upstream simulator, sample environments, demo launch files and media have been removed from this branch. The original upstream revision and file identities are recorded in `UPSTREAM_MANIFEST.txt`; that manifest describes the original import, rather than the current file inventory. The upstream GPL-3.0 license is retained.

Build and run from this repository's [root README](../../README.md). Local adaptations are described in [LOCAL_CHANGES.md](LOCAL_CHANGES.md).
